card.name: Mixed general web text, no clear pattern
card.fires_on: No single word or setting stands out. It fires on scattered tokens such as 'such', 'isn', 'don', a space after a page or date, and a closing parenthesis in general web prose.
card.plain: It responds to a random mix of small words and punctuation in ordinary web text, with no pattern a reader could rely on.
